edits.new: 7. SandboxGenerator: seeds the 19 schemas table by table in foreign key order, each table in the schema named by the Ownership Map, with seed 20261128 and 1,226 Mortgage, 1,296 Hire purchase and 290 SSME cases (2,812 in total, split by table owner in the Ownership Map) plus their accounts, parties, contact points, collateral, valuations, payments and interactions, linked by business key only. Each schema is seeded from its own baseline; no schema is seeded from another service's baseline, and the case rows are seeded once, in `rwb_case`, with the other schemas referencing them by plain business key. Each active case carries one open task and one active timer; the timer offsets beyond the FSD P3 worked case are rows of the timer table set at load review. The cases are distributed by product group to the queue rows of the seed file, and every member is capped at 40 open cases. The build report publishes the per-schema row counts.
